text: I love Saturdays because my dad lets me play video games all morning. First, I played Minecraft with my best friend. We built a huge castle made of diamond blocks, but a creeper blew up the front door. It was so funny! Then I watched a show about Pokemon. Pikachu is my favorite because he is super fast. Later, I played Roblox and did an obstacle course. I fell off a lot, but I finally won a gold badge. Video games are the best thing ever!

I can't believe we found a secret door in the library! It was hidden right behind the dusty history books. No way! I told my best friend Leo to be quiet, but he gasped so loud. "Shh! We're gonna get caught!" I whispered. We pushed the door open just a tiny bit. Pitch black inside. Oh man! I don't think I'm brave enough to go in there alone. "You go first," Leo said, shaking his head. "Not a chance!" I replied. Maybe we should just tell the librarian. Or maybe... we just need a flashlight. Wow! Imagine if there's treasure!

One day I was playing in the backyard with my sister. She was pretending to be a brave knight with a shiny sword made of cardboard. She ran straight at the big oak tree like it was a monster! "Take that!" she yelled. Then she threw a ball but it got caught in the branches. "Oh no," I said. "I'm not tall enough to reach it." We thought about climbing up, but Mom called us for dinner. We had to go inside through the back door, but we promised to save the ball tomorrow.

I couldn't believe my eyes when I walked into the kitchen. No way! My dog, Buster, was standing right on top of the table. He was eating the whole pepperoni pizza! "Buster, get down!" I yelled, but he didn't listen. He just wagged his tail like it was a big joke. Oh man! Mom is going to be so mad when she gets home. We're definitely not having pizza for dinner now. It's a huge mess everywhere. I guess we're having cereal instead. Totally unfair.

We’re running through the tall grass, and suddenly, guess what? A tiny baby bunny was just sitting there. Wow! We didn’t even care about the ball anymore. It was the best recess ever.
